state:
- The ubiquinone–DHODH timing, genotype-tracked differentiation and orthogonal rescues provide exceptional specificity, but salvage eligibility is ambiguous: uridine must fail to restore UTP yet reverse teriflunomide. Specify physiological versus supraphysiological rescue concentrations and operationally distinguish inadequate physiological salvage from defective salvage machinery.
- A biochemical EC50 below unbound Cmax does not establish sustained marrow exposure sufficient for differentiation or clonogenic suppression. Compare concentration–duration requirements with unbound marrow pharmacokinetics; distinguish exposure infeasibility from falsification of the biological mechanism.
- Novelty remains unverified, and selecting only FAO-enriched, DHODH-inhibitor-responsive specimens cannot establish that the proposed residual-state context predicts response. Check prior atovaquone/ETC–DHODH studies and include matched salvage-high/low and FAO-high/low residual-cell comparisons to test the claimed contextual specificity.
